objective: The first spot is a fixed number of lines below its value -- bookmark, copy, jump down, drop it in, jump back.
The second is further below -- same idea, a different distance and a different register.
The third spot isn't a fixed distance away -- search for it instead.
The fourth and fifth are identical in shape -- record a macro on the fourth and replay it on the fifth.
The sixth is reversed -- the spot is above the value, not below it.
The seventh reuses a value already sitting in a register from a spot earlier -- no fresh copy needed.
